 Sign In F1’s US return sees sponsorship activity ramp up
 BlackBook Motorsport breaks down the new partnerships announced ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix. October 23, 2026 
 Cian Brittle 
 Getty Images Formula One is using its return to the Austin’s Circuit of The Americas (COTA) for the United States Grand Prix to announce a slew of new partnerships. 
 The country, once a relative backwater, also hosts races in the Miami and Las Vegas and has become hugely important to the commercial fortunes of the sport. In addition to delivering a significant new audience, the US is also a key market for Formula One sponsors and those of its teams.
 The US Grand Prix is therefore considered one of the tentpole events of the calendar and a prime opportunity to activate and announce partnerships both globally and to a North American audience. Several teams, including Mercedes, Haas and Aston Martin are running special one-off liveries to commemorate existing partners, while others are using it as a platform for new deals.
 Not only that, MotoGP is also using the opportunity to conduct a demonstration – the first time it has collaborated with Formula One on a race weekend since the Liberty Media takeover. Alpine driver Franco Colapinto has already been seen riding a Pramac bike in the paddock.
 Expect to see even more deals announced as we prepare for the Las Vegas Grand Prix next month. Until then, BlackBook Motorsport brings you all the deals from a busy week for Formula One’s commercial teams.
 Read more: F1, rollercoasters and premium clubs: Inside COTA’s plan to create a year-round business 
 Alpine
 Partner: Adobe
 Designation: Official AI fan experience partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  Starting in 2027, the team will gain access to AI software through Adobe’s CX Enterprise platform, promising to create and personalise digital fan experiences. It will also help engage consumers who learn more on AI agents and large language models (LLMs) as part of their online activity. Fans will also get access to design tools as part of the partnership.
 Aston Martin
 Partner: BoxBox
 Designation: Official men’s personal care partner, official pit stop partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  Interestingly, BoxBox joins the Aston Martin partnership portfolio without anything to sell. The company is developing its products with feedback from trackside team members, combining research-led formulations with automotive-inspired design. This will continue for the remainder of 2026 and into the start of next season ahead of a planned launch in mid-2027. The company also becomes the team’s first official pit stop partner with branding on the sidepods of the car and the team’s pit crew kit, including helmets, gloves and jacks.
 Partner: Padeltek
 Designation: Official partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  This licensing collaboration will see three Padeltek padel rackets and three Padeltek Cover Bags produced with Aston Martin branding. The range will include a team racket alongside a drivers range racket.. The collaboration will continue to expand in 2027, with the introduction of pickleball rackets and accessories.
 Audi
 Partner: Elastic
 Designation: Official search and observability supplier 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  The company joins as an official race partner for the United States Grand Prix ahead of beginning its official designation as a team partner in 2027. Elastic has already supplied Audi with its technology, so this represents a formalisation of that relationship. The technology is a foundation of Audi’s central software logging platform, and the team also uses Elastic on trackside to investigate logs from wheel-set management software.
 Cadillac
 Partner: Frontieras North America
 Designation: Official energy transformation partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  The US-based company will look to use the Formula One platform to build visibility on a global stage. The focus will not only be on translating its message for fans, but to explore potential collaborations with investors and partners in the paddock.
 Haas
 Partner: Dynamo Capital
 Designation: Official partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  The deal with the private real estate lender will be focused on the North American market and represents an opportunity for Haas to strengthen its presence in its homeland.
 McLaren
 Partner: AbbVie
 Designation: Official pharmaceutical partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details: Starting at the United States Grand Prix, every 10 Constructors’ Championship points scored by McLaren will unlock a US$10,000 donation from AbbVie, reflecting approximately 10 per cent of the global population impacted by autoimmune diseases.
 Partner: Airwallex
 Designation: Official AI finance partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details: From 2027, Airwallex will upgrade its existing role as an official technology partner, gaining additional exposure on team kit. Its brand is already present on the car’s halo and driver overalls.
 Mercedes
 Partner: Stripe
 Designation: Official global payments partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details:  Stripe’s branding will debut on the team’s cars and across team assets from the first race of the 2027 season, with the payment provider deploying its tech acoss the team’s operations and at key races, including the team’s retail experience.
 Racing Bulls
 Partner: Introl
 Designation: Official data centre deployment partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details: The collaboration builds on Introl’s longstanding relationship with Liam Lawson, whom the company has supported for several years. As part of the partnership, Introl branding now features on the nose of the car and across the team’s garage partner stacks..
 Williams
 Partner: Klaviyo
 Designation: Official B2C CRM partner 
 Duration: Multi-year 
 Details: Branding will appear on the cars from 2027, as well as the steering wheel, driver racesuits, and team kit. Williams will use Klaviyo’s B2C CRM to build deeper relationships with its growing global fanbase, bringing fans closer to the team through more relevant, personal experiences across channels and continents.
